name: CCTV Network Scanner
description: Scans a given IP network range for open ports commonly used by CCTV cameras (RTSP/ONVIF: 554, 80, 8080, 1935). Returns list of live IPs and open ports.
author: aether-forge

spec.description: Scans a given IP network range for open ports commonly used by CCTV cameras (RTSP/ONVIF: 554, 80, 8080, 1935). Returns list of live IPs and open ports.

ports.description: Comma-separated list of ports to scan (default: 554,80,8080,1935)
